result.quote: all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal
result.reason: The people tear down Baal’s temple, including its altars and idols, and kill Mattan. The key accurately summarizes these actions; “Baal’s house” is an acceptable paraphrase of “the temple of Baal.”
